mapper.select: SELECT PRJ_NO , USER_ID , PROJECT_BOARD_NO , PROJECT_NAME , PROJECT_CONTENTS , PROJECT_STATUS , CREATE_DATE , FINISH_DATE , DELETE_DATE FROM PROJECT

SELECT P.PRJ_NO, P.USER_ID, P.PROJECT_BOARD_NO, P.PROJECT_NAME, P.PROJECT_CONTENTS, P.PROJECT_STATUS, -- 상태명은 코드 테이블 join 또는 CASE WHEN으로 처리 가능 P.CREATE_DATE, P.FINISH_DATE, P.DELETE_DATE, P.PROJECT_COLOR, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROGRESS_RATE, 0))) FROM PRJ_TASK WHERE PRJ_NO = P.PRJ_NO) AS AVG_PROGRESS,
-- 멤버 정보 M.PRJ_NO AS MEM_PRJ_NO, M.USER_ID AS MEM_USER_ID, M.AUTHORITY_CODE, M.DELETE_DATE AS MEM_DELETE_DATE, M.USER_NAME, M.USER_POSITION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRJ_MEM WHERE PRJ_NO = P.PRJ_NO) AS MEM_CNT, -- 채팅방 정보 C.CHATROOM_NO, C.PRJ_NO AS CHAT_PRJ_NO, C.CHATROOM_NAME
FROM PROJECT P -- 내가 소속된 프로젝트만 INNER JOIN PRJ_MEM M ON P.PRJ_NO = M.PRJ_NO LEFT JOIN CHATROOM C ON P.PRJ_NO = C.PRJ_NO WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY P.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT -- Project p.prj_no, p.user_id, p.project_board_no, p.project_name, p.project_contents, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE WHERE CODE_DETAIL_NO = p.project_status) as project_status, p.create_date, p.finish_date, p.delete_date, p.project_color, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROGRESS_RATE, 0))) FROM PRJ_TASK WHERE PRJ_NO = P.PRJ_NO) AS AVG_PROGRESS,
-- PrjMem (프로젝트 멤버) pm.prj_no AS mem_prj_no, pm.user_id AS mem_user_id, pm.authority_code, pm.delete_date AS mem_delete_date, pm.user_name, pm.user_position,
-- Chatroom (채팅방) c.chatroom_no, c.prj_no AS chat_prj_no, c.chatroom_name,
-- ChatroomMem (채팅방 멤버) cm.chatroom_no AS chmem_chatroom_no, cm.prj_no AS chmem_prj_no, cm.user_id AS chmem_user_id, cm.read_message_no FROM project p LEFT JOIN prj_mem pm ON p.prj_no = pm.prj_no LEFT JOIN chatroom c ON p.prj_no = c.prj_no LEFT JOIN chatroom_mem cm ON c.chatroom_no = cm.chatroom_no WHERE p.prj_no = #{prjNo}
